scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn --app-dir src civil_engineering.main:app --reload
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn --app-dir src civil_engineering.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.format:check: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.db:upgrade: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
